subject: Intro + Sponsor request — aligning VP/CIO availability for product demo
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@aurorion.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Sponsor request — aligning VP/CIO availability for product demo

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the time earlier — really appreciated the quick intro and high-level context about Aurorion's evaluation criteria. We're excited to walk the team through Redwood's inference platform and show the throughput/latency story with a short, focused exec briefing + technical deep dive.

High-level ask: can you confirm whether your VP of Engineering or CIO (you mentioned Daniel) would be able to join a 45-minute session so we can cover architecture, SLA/rollout model, and a brief roadmap alignment? We find it helps accelerate procurement when an exec sponsor is on the call for the first demo.

Two windows that work well on our side next week (PT):
- Tue, Jul 7 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed, Jul 8 — 13:00–13:45 PT

If neither of those work, please share two slots that do. I've attached a short agenda and a couple of pre-demo questions so we can tailor the session.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

Next steps: if you can confirm Daniel's availability (or an alternate exec sponsor), Ben and I will hold the slot and send a calendar invite with a brief run of show.

Thanks — appreciate the help coordinating.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@aurorion.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + Sponsor request — aligning VP/CIO availability for product demo

Thanks, Stephanie — appreciate the agenda.

Quick note on availability: Daniel (CIO) is traveling the week of July 6 and is tightly packed, but he can make the morning of Tue, Jul 7 US/Eastern before he hops a flight — around 13:00–13:45 UTC (which I think maps to your 10:00–10:45 PT). I can also invite our VP of Platform, Priya Khanna, as an alternate if Daniel can't make the full session.

A couple of housekeeping items:
- We need a brief (1–2 slide) summary of security/compliance posture up front — SOC2 and data residency notes are the top asks from procurement.
- Can you confirm whether you can run a short Q&A at the end for our architecture leads (they prefer 10–15 mins)?

If that Tue morning works, pencil it and send a hold. I'll confirm Daniel or Priya by EOD Friday.

—Olivia
Head of Platform Partnerships | Aurorion
olivia@aurorion.com | (617) 555-0128
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@aurorion.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Sponsor request — aligning VP/CIO availability for product demo

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick reply and the clarity on Daniel's travel. Tue, Jul 7 at 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET works for our team; I'm holding a 45-minute session (10:00–10:45 PT).

Marcus (cc'd) will lead the brief architecture walkthrough; Stephanie will cover the exec-level value props and procurement hooks. We'll plan: 15 min exec overview + 20 min technical demo + 10 min Q&A. We'll include a 2-slide security snapshot at the top that covers SOC 2, data residency, and KMS options.

Olivia — can you share which people from Aurorion you expect (names + titles) so we send calendar invites to the right folks? Also attaching a short pre-demo questionnaire that helps Marcus prepare for the demo (networking/ingress, model runtime constraints, PII concerns).

Attachments: pre-demo-questions.pdf (PDF, 22KB)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2345678 (provisional deal record)

If Daniel is a maybe, we will still run the session and ensure a concise exec summary so the CIO can get the highlights asynchronously. If Priya is joining, that's great too — either counts as sponsor presence.

Thanks — Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0190

Ben — thanks for taking point on the agenda and the security snapshot.

Olivia — thanks for penciling Tue, Jul 7. If you can confirm Daniel or Priya by Friday EOD, we'll finalize the calendar invite and attach the 2-slide SOC2/data-residency note and a one-page procurement checklist for Aurorion's vendor team.

Planning notes for internal coverage:
- Marcus: run the demo with the standard 45-minute runbook; please prepare a 3-slide appendix that calls out latency/cost tradeoffs (we may need to drop deeper metric tables if exec time is tight).
- Ben: please add the HubSpot event link to the invite and mark the deal as 'demo-scheduled' so solutions engineering gets the pre-demo folder.
- If Daniel cannot join, we will ask for a 15-min follow-up with him. If Priya is the sponsor, ensure the invite includes the procurement checklist.

I'll draft the calendar invite after we get confirmation; Ben hold the original slot as tentative until Olivia confirms attendees.
